PMF.productChannel: For finitely many channels Wᵢ with finite output alphabets, the product channel takes an input vector x and draws the output coordinates independently, with coordinate i distributed as Wᵢ(·|xᵢ). The input alphabets may be infinite.
PMF.productChannel_apply: For input vector x, the probability of output vector y under the product channel is ∏ᵢ Wᵢ(yᵢ|xᵢ).
PMF.mem_support_productChannel_iff: Given x, a word y has positive probability under the product channel exactly when each factor Wᵢ(yᵢ|xᵢ) is positive.
PMF.productChannel_map_eval: At input vector x, the i-th output marginal of the product channel is the single-coordinate row Wᵢ(·|xᵢ).
PMF.productChannel_map_restrict: Selecting output coordinates by an injection e gives the product channel on those coordinates. Its component at j uses the original channel and input symbol at index e(j).
PMF.finiteProduct_bind_productChannel: Passing independent inputs with respective laws pᵢ through a product channel gives independent outputs. Output i has law pᵢ passed through Wᵢ.
PMF.channelComp_productChannel: At each of finitely many coordinates, let Wᵢ feed into Vᵢ through a finite intermediate alphabet, with a finite output alphabet for Vᵢ. Cascading the two product channels gives the product of the coordinatewise cascades Wᵢ followed by Vᵢ. The input alphabets of Wᵢ may be infinite.
PMF.productChannel_deterministicChannel: The product of deterministic channels fᵢ is the deterministic map sending x to the vector with entries fᵢ(xᵢ).
PMF.memorylessChannel: For a finite output alphabet, the n-use memoryless extension of W sends x to the product of the n rows W(·|xᵢ). Outputs are conditionally independent given x.
PMF.channelJoint_productChannel_map_eval: For any input-vector law q, the marginal law of the i-th input–output pair under the product channel is the joint law induced by the i-th input marginal and channel Wᵢ.
PMF.channelJoint_productChannel_map_rest: For any input law q and any injection selecting coordinates, the joint law of the selected inputs and outputs is obtained by passing the selected input marginal through the selected product channel.
PMF.finiteProduct_channelJoint_map: Draw independent pairs with respective joint laws induced by pᵢ and Wᵢ. Regrouping their coordinates as an input vector and an output vector gives the joint law of the product input through the product channel.
